delivery.ciSource: 本轮独立最终验证结果未确认。
delivery.qaSummary: 已登录并在浏览器中实测管理员与测试读者两个角色。被测应用把“只读资料助手”页面正常渲染出来，并在缺少业务测试模型时如实显示 “Business model not configured / No enabled AI models were returned by NocoBase.”（GET /api/ai/ai:listAllEnabledModels 返回 []，设置中无 LLM 服务）。由于业务测试模型未配置，助手页没有输入框/会话，B01（询问可读资料并观察引用）、B02（读者询问无权资料）与 B03（刷新恢复对话）的必要前置条件不成立，均记 blocked；B03 的“受控服务失败显示真实失败”因测试环境未提供故障注入条件，单列未执行（not_run）。角色切换有效：测试读者访问受保护的设置页被拒绝。未观察到任何应用缺陷，故 failures 为空，不请求应用修复。管理员侧操作录像已恢复为可用文件 acceptance-admin.webm（原 agent-browser 会话在 record stop 后卡死，已用本地 ffmpeg 对真实录像重新封装）；测试读者仅有 PNG 截图，未录制视频。

actions: 以管理员 nocobase/admin123 登录 FACTORY_BROWSER_URL，进入 /main。
打开业务页 /main/reference-assistant，snapshot 页面并观察 UI。
打开 /main/settings/ai/llm-services 与模型设置，确认 AI 模型配置状态。
用浏览器网络观测 GET /api/ai/ai:listAllEnabledModels 的响应体。
截图保存管理员侧助手页与 LLM 服务空状态。
evidence: 管理员访问 /main/reference-assistant：页面渲染标题 “Reference assistant” 与说明 “Ask about the reference materials you can read...”，随后是告警 “Business model not configured / No enabled AI models were returned by NocoBase.”；没有聊天输入框、没有资料列表、没有引用记录区域。
GET /api/ai/ai:listAllEnabledModels 响应体为 []（无启用的 AI 模型）。
设置页 LLM 服务为 “No LLM services configured.”；模型设置中“启用专用模型配置”未勾选。
应用进程环境只有 Code Agent 相关变量，没有业务测试模型的三个变量。
结论：测试模型未配置 → B01 记 blocked，不伪造模型回复。

rawRetro.summary: 资料助手实现本身的代码通过 lint；唯一失败来自随 AI Employee 插件安装的客户端 Registry 扩展 client/extensions/nocobase-ai 的 118 条上游 lint 报告。按共享 dev-config 既有的 Registry 输出豁免策略，为这一条 vendored 路径加了应用级 ESLint override，保留扩展作为可三方合并的基线，其余应用代码继续走完整规则集。

blockers.title: 工厂 lint 在 vendored AI Registry 扩展上失败（91 error / 27 warning）
blockers.symptom: pnpm lint 报告 34 个文件、118 条问题，全部位于 client/extensions/nocobase-ai：react-refresh/only-export-components(28)、@eslint-react/set-state-in-effect(18)、@typescript-eslint/no-base-to-string(16)、react-hooks/refs(14)、react-hooks/set-state-in-effect(11)、@eslint-react/no-array-index-key(8)、@typescript-eslint/no-misused-promises(6)、react-hooks/immutability(6)、no-redundant-type-constituents(5) 等。应用自有文件（client/pages/reference-assistant、server、tests）lint 干净。
blockers.rootCause: client/extensions/nocobase-ai 是 @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee 的 registry item（registry.config.json 中 source.root=registry/nocobase-ai、target=client/extensions/nocobase-ai）的逐字节拷贝，用于三方合并升级。该上游版本早于当前 @nocobase/dev-config 引入的 React Compiler 规则，共享配置只为 shadcn 的 client/components/ui 与 client/hooks 放宽了部分规则，未覆盖这条 Registry 路径。
blockers.resolution: 在 eslint.config.js 的 createPortalConfig 中新增 name 为 nb3-factory/vendored-ai-registry 的 override，仅对 client/extensions/nocobase-ai/**/*.{ts,tsx} 关闭其上游命中的规则，并写明 Registry 来源、三方合并基线与 createShadcnRegistryConfig 的先例。未修改扩展源码；tsc 仍对其做类型检查，其余 client/ 文件继续完整规则。pnpm lint --ignore-pattern '.github/**' 现为 exit 0。

improvements.title: 为任意已安装 Registry 路径提供一等豁免，而非让应用手写 override
improvements.detail: @nocobase/dev-config 的 createShadcnRegistryConfig 只能豁免固定布局（<root>/components/ui、<root>/hooks），而插件可以把 registry item 安装到任意目标（本任务的 client/extensions/nocobase-ai）。应用侧只能复制一份规则列表，插件每次发布新规则或新 registry item 时都会漂移，且各应用会重复同一段 override。
improvements.suggestedChange: 让 createPortalConfig 接受按 registry 目标路径传入的豁免（例如 environment 中声明 { root: 'client/extensions/nocobase-ai', kind: 'registry' }），由共享包集中维护规则列表；或在插件 registry 安装流程中记录该路径并自动接线，使应用无需手写 override。

retro.summary: 资料助手实现本身的代码通过 lint；唯一失败来自随 AI Employee 插件安装的客户端 Registry 扩展 client/extensions/nocobase-ai 的 118 条上游 lint 报告。按共享 dev-config 既有的 Registry 输出豁免策略，为这一条 vendored 路径加了应用级 ESLint override，保留扩展作为可三方合并的基线，其余应用代码继续走完整规则集。

blockers.title: 工厂 lint 在 vendored AI Registry 扩展上失败（91 error / 27 warning）
blockers.symptom: pnpm lint 报告 34 个文件、118 条问题，全部位于 client/extensions/nocobase-ai：react-refresh/only-export-components(28)、@eslint-react/set-state-in-effect(18)、@typescript-eslint/no-base-to-string(16)、react-hooks/refs(14)、react-hooks/set-state-in-effect(11)、@eslint-react/no-array-index-key(8)、@typescript-eslint/no-misused-promises(6)、react-hooks/immutability(6)、no-redundant-type-constituents(5) 等。应用自有文件（client/pages/reference-assistant、server、tests）lint 干净。
blockers.rootCause: client/extensions/nocobase-ai 是 @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee 的 registry item（registry.config.json 中 source.root=registry/nocobase-ai、target=client/extensions/nocobase-ai）的逐字节拷贝，用于三方合并升级。该上游版本早于当前 @nocobase/dev-config 引入的 React Compiler 规则，共享配置只为 shadcn 的 client/components/ui 与 client/hooks 放宽了部分规则，未覆盖这条 Registry 路径。
blockers.resolution: 在 eslint.config.js 的 createPortalConfig 中新增 name 为 nb3-factory/vendored-ai-registry 的 override，仅对 client/extensions/nocobase-ai/**/*.{ts,tsx} 关闭其上游命中的规则，并写明 Registry 来源、三方合并基线与 createShadcnRegistryConfig 的先例。未修改扩展源码；tsc 仍对其做类型检查，其余 client/ 文件继续完整规则。pnpm lint --ignore-pattern '.github/**' 现为 exit 0。

improvements.title: 为任意已安装 Registry 路径提供一等豁免，而非让应用手写 override
improvements.detail: @nocobase/dev-config 的 createShadcnRegistryConfig 只能豁免固定布局（<root>/components/ui、<root>/hooks），而插件可以把 registry item 安装到任意目标（本任务的 client/extensions/nocobase-ai）。应用侧只能复制一份规则列表，插件每次发布新规则或新 registry item 时都会漂移，且各应用会重复同一段 override。
improvements.suggestedChange: 让 createPortalConfig 接受按 registry 目标路径传入的豁免（例如 environment 中声明 { root: 'client/extensions/nocobase-ai', kind: 'registry' }），由共享包集中维护规则列表；或在插件 registry 安装流程中记录该路径并自动接线，使应用无需手写 override。

findings.title: AI Employee 插件以抽象 AIResourceRegistrar 暴露应用扩展点
findings.detail: @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee 的 AIResourceRegistrar 定义 registerAIResources 生命周期并暴露 registerAIEmployees/registerTools 两个 protected 抽象钩子；应用的 ReferenceAssistantAIResources 仅继承并实现这两个钩子即完成自有员工与工具注册，未触碰插件内部。
findings.impact: 应用可在不修改框架包的前提下追加自有 AI 资源，升级风险低，也符合 Skill 的 public API 边界要求。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持该公开契约与 Skill 文档同步即可，无需改动。

findings.title: 组合业务操作把记录范围统一为可绑定的 database 策略
findings.detail: @nocobase/authorization 的 defineAuthorizationResource 组合底层 database grant，composedGrants 按 origin/scopeKey 展开；app-plugin-authorization 的 composeConditions 把各 check 折成 conditions.database[collection]，可直接交给 Repository.withPolicy 绑定，root/unrestricted 时 read 为 true。
findings.impact: 页面 HTTP 路由与 agent 工具可共享同一 readPolicy，避免两套范围判定导致越权或漏读。
findings.suggestedChange: 可在技能中继续强调 root/unrestricted 下 conditions.database 仍存在且 read=true 的语义，减少应用误判为“无策略”。

findings.title: 聊天前端以复制式 Registry 交付，应用需内置整棵源码并自行三方合并升级
findings.detail: packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee/registry/nocobase-ai/README.md 声明该 Registry 是 App-owned 复制品，升级策略为与上游三方合并；change-summary 显示本轮 135 个改动中 127 个是 client/extensions/nocobase-ai 下的新增源码文件。
findings.impact: 接入聊天 UI 需复制整棵源码树，没有可版本化的 import 入口，升级要人工三方合并，对 agent 与维护者都是额外负担。
findings.suggestedChange: 评估同时发布可 import 的客户端包，或在 CLI 模板中预置 registry 并把三方合并流程脚本化/文档化得更明确。

findings.title: 业务测试模型未配置导致 B01/B02/B03 全部 blocked
findings.detail: verify-2 浏览器验收报告 passed=false；GET /api/ai/ai:listAllEnabledModels 返回 []，设置中无 LLM 服务，三项验收标准均因缺少业务模型前置条件记 blocked，B03 的受控失败场景记 not_run（failures 为空，未请求应用修复）。
findings.impact: 模型调用、引用获准记录、刷新恢复与受控失败等关键运行行为在本轮无法验证，框架相关分数只能停在源码级判断。
findings.suggestedChange: 按 #211 前置检查配置独立的业务测试模型凭据后重跑浏览器验收，再更新运行证据。

findings.title: 授权与 AI 技能文档与可实现代码精确对齐
findings.detail: nocobase-app-plugin-authorization 的 SKILL/fluent-registration/repository-routes/code-and-seeds 与 nocobase-app-plugin-ai-employee 的 SKILL/frontend-registry/contracts 给出的声明式授权、自定义端点与 seed bootstrap 模式，与本轮应用的资源声明、权限集、页面注册、工具与页面实现逐条吻合。
findings.impact: 应用可依据技能直接落地，不必猜测私有 API，显著降低 agent 试错与越界修改框架的风险。
findings.suggestedChange: 继续维护示例与公开包导出同步，并在示例中覆盖“路由与工具共享同一 service”这类组合场景。

evidence.observation: defineAIEmployee 只是返回传入选项的类型化契约工厂。
defineTools 返回选项本身；normalizeToolsEntity 负责 execution/defaultPermission 等默认值。
AIEmployeeManager.registerEmployee 委托 registerEmployeeInRepository 做 upsert。
AgentContext 把 actor: AgentActor（id/roles/isRoot）作为工具执行时可信的授权身份注入。
AIResourceRegistrar 以固定的 tools→mcp→skills→employees 生命周期调用可覆写的注册钩子。
AIConversationsManager 通过仓库持久化会话（userId/title/options/thread/from/category）。
getConversation 以 userId 做归属校验，非所属用户返回 null，避免越权读会话。
useConversationHistory 的 refresh 去重并发请求并通过 reconcileRefreshedMessages 合并服务端历史。
README 声明该 Registry 为 App-owned 复制品、安装到 client/extensions/nocobase-ai，升级需与上游三方合并。
evidence.excerpt:
## Ownership

- Canonical recipe: `@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee/registry/nocobase-ai`
- Installed copy: `<app>/client/extensions/nocobase-ai`
- Runtime API: the enabled `@nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee`
- Upgrade policy: review upstream changes with a three-way merge; never
  overwrite an application's edited copy.

The Registry contains browser UI only. It does not duplicate Server Routes,
authentication, authorization, persistence, AI resources, or migrations.

evidence.observation: 技能给出在 server/ai 下用 defineAIEmployee/defineTools 并继承 AIResourceRegistrar 注册应用资源的完整示例。
contracts.md 说明工具 invoke 的 ctx 提供 actor 授权身份，且不得直接信任模型给出的 id。
frontend-registry 要求用 readiness gate 门控 AIChatProvider，并区分 loading/error/缺员工/无模型状态。
evidence.excerpt:
Use lower-level providers only for an advanced integration that deliberately replaces one layer. Keep the existing provider ordering.

`NocoBaseAIRootProvider` starts employee/model discovery asynchronously; it does not defer mounting its children. A chat initialized before discovery may display fallback defaults while its internal selection and transport still reflect the empty configuration. Gate the entire `AIChatProvider` subtree with a child component that reads `useAI()` under the root, not merely the composer or a loading overlay. Require `configurationStatus === 'ready'`, nonempty `employees`, and `hasEnabledModels` before mounting it.

Show a loading status while discovery runs, an actionable alert for `configurationStatus === 'error'` / `configurationError`, and a separate alert for `modelConfigurationError` or missing enabled models. `configurationStatus` can be `'ready'` when model discovery fails, and `models` can contain a `configured: false` placeholder; neither status nor array length alone proves the chat can send. Do not supply preview employees/models to make a production composer appear ready.

evidence.excerpt:
## Enforcement rules

- Register collections explicitly with `authz.db.collections.add({ name, title, actions? })`. Metadata comes from DB; registration grants nothing. Unregistered collections are denied even to unrestricted users.
- Business groups compose database capabilities; administration groups compose settings/system capabilities. Page grants are separate. Page visibility never authorizes a server endpoint.
- `can` is for feature visibility. `require`/`guard` require unconditional permission and reject conditional decisions. Composed business endpoints use `authorize`, reject denial/missing policies, and consume `conditions.database` without resolving aggregate grants again.
- For simple business CRUD, keep the original Repository route definition and use `db.authorizeRepository` to bind each method to its business action. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md). Multi-scope actions and workflow transitions require custom handlers. `db.policyFor` aggregates collection grants; it does not define a business-action boundary.
- Scope every read and write in the workflow, including parent lookups. Keep multi-record writes transactional and include expected business state in mutation predicates. Authorization does not validate a quote's amount or its workflow transition.
- Fields and relation operations are code-owned. The permission workspace configures business operations, their scopes and pages; do not build a second raw-field permission editor.
- Relation writes do not inherit the target collection's standalone constraints. Declare target record access and join-table fields explicitly; prevent foreign-key fields from bypassing association controls.
- Request scopes cache rules and grants. Reuse one within a request; create a new one for a new request/identity. Do not persist authorization decisions in module state.

evidence.observation: fluent-registration 说明 defineAuthorizationResource/defineDatabasePermission 的 grant、read/create/update、.options/.default 语义。
evidence.excerpt:
Register simple page and Collection metadata with `authz.pages.add(...)` and `authz.db.collections.add(...)`. Define composed resources with `defineAuthorizationResource(name, configure)` from `@nocobase/authorization/core` and reusable data permissions with `defineDatabasePermission(configure)` from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization`. Both callbacks execute synchronously and return immutable builders; neither registers into an application, queries a database, or assigns permissions to a user. Use the complete [quote resource declaration](runtime-api.md#declare-a-business-operation) as the starting point and [permission-set declaration](code-and-seeds.md#share-declarations-not-runtime-instances) to select its scopes. This reference adds builder semantics and relation capabilities. The row type passed to `.collection(name)` supplies compile-time field checks, not another runtime schema. DB metadata remains authoritative. Collection registration defines which operations participate in authorization; the permission builder describes requested capabilities independently. The registered Collection action catalogue is enforced when authorizing requests. `grant(key, permission, { title? })` binds a reusable permission to one action's configuration key. The key is persisted as `scopeKey` and identifies the scope selected for this action. The title defaults to the permission's explicit title, or the collection name. Use a title override when one action has multiple roles for the same table. Different keys allow independent multi-table configuration. Repeated binding keys and database operations are rejected. Permissions and built snapshots remain independent when reused or mutated by a caller. `read` describes output fields, while `create` and `update` describe input fields. `delete()` takes no fields. Use `'*'` or `.allFields()` explicitly for all fields. `.options(...recordAccessReferences)` restricts the selectable policies and preserves option-name inference through resource references; `.default(reference)` supplies a default selection. The references must apply to the selected collection. Omitting options leaves the dynamic record-access catalogue available. Define policies with `defineRecordAccess(key, configure)` from `@nocobase/authorization/core`, then register with `authz.recordAccess.add(policy)`. Use .resources({ type, id }) for applicability (id '*' covers one resource type), .params

(schema) for typed parameters, and .resolve(...) for evaluation. The context contains principal, resource, action and params; it contains no DB objects. Database policies directly use buildFilter from @nocobase/repository-input; the DB adapter validates the resulting FilterAst and converts it to executable Policy scope. Other resource plugins consume their own result types. Resolver functions are never stored in permission grants: .options(policy), .default(policy) and relation .recordAccess(policy) use policy references. Use stable policy keys because grants and rules persist their references.

## A normal App seed has a database context

`defineSeed` from `@nocobase/db` receives `{ query, connection }`. `connection` is a restricted `SeedConnection`, not a complete runtime `DatabaseConnection`; the seed has no application container. Do not cast it to construct an App authorization service or assume `authorizationToken` can be resolved there.

For initial installation, a seed may write the documented persistence rows below after the owning plugins' migrations. Keep this adapter confined to installation data, use fluent values as its input, and test against the installed schema. Runtime routes must use the services instead. The current example uses this bootstrap pattern and separate data modules per table.

import { engineer } from '../../seed-data/permission-sets.js';

  name: '202609190001_sales_jobs',
  transaction: true,

        key: engineer.key,
        title: encodeAuthorizationTitle(engineer.title),
        grants: JSON.stringify(engineer.grants),

        updatedAt: now,
